hints.title: Two-Way Bijection Invariant
hints.text: A valid pattern match requires an exact one-to-one character correspondence between the word and pattern.

hints.title: Mutual Mapping Verification
hints.text: Map each character of word to pattern and simultaneously map each character of pattern to word.

hints.title: Inconsistency Rejection
hints.text: If any character maps to two different targets in either direction, reject the candidate word.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Bijection mapping check for each candidate word.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking only one direction allows multiple pattern letters to map to the same word character.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant alphabet space bounded by 26 characters.
